sources.title: DeFranco, On Boolean polynomials and the Union-Closed Conjecture
sources.read_scope: abstract, version history and HTML introductory definitions
sources.supports: An equivalent Boolean formulation, not a general proof; distinct-set requirements appear in the formulation.

sources.title: Gilmer, A constant lower bound for the union-closed sets conjecture
sources.read_scope: abstract, version history; HTML opened, not full proof audited
sources.supports: A constant 0.01 lower bound is partial progress. Version notes acknowledge typo fixes and refutation of an ancillary conjecture; this is not Frankl's half-bound proof.

sources.title: OEIS A102896
sources.supports: Moore-family counts 2/7/61/2480 for m=1..4. Complement maps universe-containing intersection-closed families to empty-containing union-closed families; this explains r1/r2 count conventions.

sources.title: Hu, On the Union-Closed Sets Conjecture
